name: Wanna. ~SpartanSex Spermax!!!~
original_name: Wanna.〜スパルタンセックス スペルマックス!!!〜
source:
Tanabe Yoshiyuki disappeared and it was discovered he was bullied in school. Nagisa, Yoshiyuki's cousin, decided to dress up as a male in order to find out what happened to him and to exact revenge on those responsible for the bullying.

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=17136]AnimeNewsNetwork[/url]]
